photos.desc: An Oleander Hawkmoth (Daphnis nerii) spotted at Madhurawada in Visakhapatnam
This beautiful army moth (Daphnis nerii) was found in a town in northern Greece.
The army moth seen from the back.
A closer look of the army moth. Its colours blend into one another creating a spectacular image.
